SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

8. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. C — Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Nairobi

4. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

5. C — Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Plan income and spending wisely

11. D — Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Population Distribution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The School; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Economic activities in the County; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
